## 1. Company Overview

- Company Name: B2BinDemand
- Global team size: 170+ specialists
- Target clients: B2B technology, SaaS, and professional services companies
- Client stage: Series B+ or mid-market to enterprise scale
- Primary audience: VP/Director-level Marketing, Demand Generation, and Revenue Operations leaders

**Core Value Proposition:**
- Identifies in-market B2B buyers
- Delivers them to your pipeline through smart content syndication, intent targeting, and event-based campaigns

**Headline Positioning:**
- "We find your next buyer before they find your competitor."

**Key Differentiators:**
1. Not just content syndication — Smart Syndication with intent-filtered, targeted distribution
2. Not just leads — BANT-verified, intent-scored, campaign-ready contacts
3. Full-funnel, multi-channel campaign architecture from a single partner
4. Real-time buyer intent signals to surface in-market accounts

---

## 3. Solutions

### 3.1 Campaigns+
- **URL:** https://b2bindemand.com/campaigns
- **SEO Title:** B2B Demand Generation Campaigns | B2BinDemand
- **Meta Description:** Launch full-funnel B2B campaigns that target the right accounts, engage buying committees, and deliver pipeline-ready leads. One partner. Every channel. No waste.
- **What it is:** Full-funnel B2B demand generation campaigns
- **What they do:** Design and run campaigns that target the right accounts, engage buying committees across the full funnel, and deliver pipeline-ready leads
- **Positioning:** Alternative to managing multiple separate vendors — one partner covering every channel

---

### 3.2 Intent Targeting
- **URL:** https://b2bindemand.com/intent-targeting
- **SEO Title:** B2B Intent Targeting & Buyer Intelligence | B2BinDemand
- **Meta Description:** Reach B2B buyers who are actively researching solutions like yours. B2BinDemand's intent targeting uses real-time signals to surface in-market accounts before your competitors do.
- **What it is:** B2B buyer intent data and real-time signal identification
- **How it works:** Uses first-party and third-party intent signals to surface accounts actively researching solutions in your category before competitors engage them

**Key Context:**
- In-market account = measurable increase in research activity around a topic relevant to your solution
- Signal types:
  - First-party signals: website visits, content engagement, email activity
  - Third-party signals: publisher networks, intent data co-ops
- Signal quality matters: content consumption signals > page view signals
- Vendor claims to scrutinise: "real-time intent", "verified signals", "buying committee identification"

---

### 3.3 Smart Syndication
- **URL:** https://b2bindemand.com/smart-syndication
- **SEO Title:** B2B Content Syndication Services | B2BinDemand
- **Meta Description:** Distribute your content to verified B2B buyers who are already in-market. B2BinDemand's Smart Syndication delivers qualified leads, not just downloads.
- **What it is:** B2B content syndication services built for qualified lead delivery, not download volume
- **How it works:** Distributes content to verified B2B buyers who are already in-market, using intent-filtered targeting rather than broad keyword-matched distribution

**Why Standard Syndication Fails:**
1. Broad targeting
2. Unverified contacts
3. Leads captured at low-intent moments

**Smart Syndication Solution:**
- Intent-filtered distribution matched to accounts already researching relevant topics
- Prioritises audience quality over placement volume
- Core principle: "The distribution is not the product. The targeting is the product."

---

### 3.4 Event-Based Lead Generation
- **URL:** https://b2bindemand.com/event-based-lead-generation
- **SEO Title:** B2B Event Lead Generation Services | B2BinDemand
- **Meta Description:** Fill your events with qualified attendees and convert them into pipeline. B2BinDemand drives B2B event registrations and post-event lead nurturing at scale.
- **What it is:** Full-cycle B2B event lead generation

**Three-Stage Process:**
1. Filling events with qualified attendees
2. Identifying in-market buyers among registered attendees pre-event
3. Converting attendees into pipeline post-event via structured nurture sequences

**Key Context:**
- Most event leads go cold within 3 days if not engaged immediately
- Intent data can identify which registered attendees are already in an active buying cycle before the event begins
- High-converting post-event follow-up depends on timing, channel mix, and personalisation based on session attendance

**The Distinction:**
- Event promotion fills seats
- Event lead generation fills pipeline
- "An event is not a lead generation moment — it is a lead acceleration moment, but only if you have the infrastructure to act on it."
